item.title: Corps news roundup: World Series ceremony, design summits, and a PASIC reunion
item.description:
DCI's latest corps news roundup covers a busy offseason stretch across the activity. ConneXion members took part in a World Series opening ceremony, putting drum corps on one of sports' biggest stages, while the Troopers opened a window into their design staff summit as they plan ahead.

Also in the roundup: Boston Crusaders' percussion section is set to reunite for a PASIC performance, and there's news from the DCI All-Age and SoundSport side of the activity. It's a snapshot of an offseason where corps are already building toward next summer, both on the field and in front of new audiences.

item.title: Seattle Cascades adding a dedicated trombone line for 2027
item.description:
The Seattle Cascades are bringing a dedicated trombone line to the field for their 2027 production, according to newly installed program coordinator and brass arranger Todd Zimbelman. The design team is already well into work on the corps' yet-to-be-revealed 2027 show, and the trombone line is one of its defining choices.

A dedicated trombone section is a distinctive instrumentation call — most corps fold trombones into the broader brass line — so it hints at a show built around the instrument's sound and visual identity. More details will presumably follow as the Cascades reveal the full 2027 production.
